item: Reader landmarks and heading levels, Time map rank box focus, a name for every table header (rows 230, 246)
key_paths: src/api/main.py; src/static/app-map.js; src/static/app-analysis.js; src/static/app-*.js; scripts/ui_clickthrough_run.py; tests/test_a11y_row230.py
summary: The article reader, the Time map ranked table and every data table now work properly with screen readers and the keyboard. The reader has proper page regions and heading levels, the ranked table can be scrolled from the keyboard, and every table column has a name a screen reader can announce.
